summary: Complete testing of multi-supplier PromoStandards integration. All backend APIs working correctly (23/23 tests passed). UI renders suppliers and products pages. Supplier CRUD, test-connection, and product sync endpoints all functional.

ui_bugs.issue: Product thumbnails show Package icon placeholder instead of images - thumbnails are null from API because media sync hasn't been triggered
ui_bugs.fix: Run media sync via Sync Jobs page to populate thumbnails

ui_bugs.issue: Some products display 'Error Product' or 'Array' as names - data quality issue from PromoStandards SOAP response parsing
ui_bugs.fix: Improve product name extraction in promostandards.py

issues: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

passed_tests: GET /api/suppliers/{id} - returns individual supplier details for ATC and S&S
POST /api/suppliers - creates new supplier with auto-endpoint discovery
PUT /api/suppliers/{id} - updates supplier name and endpoint_style
DELETE /api/suppliers/{id} - deletes supplier and verifies removal
POST /api/suppliers/{id}/test-connection - S&S returns success=false with 403 IP blocked message (expected)
GET /api/products - returns paginated products with thumbnails field
Suppliers page loads and displays supplier cards
Supplier cards show endpoint_style labels (ATC / SanMar, S&S Activewear)
Test connection button shows check/X icons based on result
Add Supplier dialog shows all fields: name, type dropdown, URL, account, password, media password, UAT toggle
Advanced Options shows custom service URL inputs
Products page loads with filters (supplier, category, brand, selection)
Navigation between Dashboard, Products, Suppliers, Sync Jobs works
action_items: Minor: Fix product name parsing in promostandards.py - some products show 'Array' or 'Error Product'
Minor: Trigger media sync to populate product thumbnails
Optional: Add aria-describedby to Dialog components for accessibility compliance
critical_code_review_comments: promostandards.py: Product name extraction could be improved - some responses return 'Array' instead of actual names
Products display $0.00 prices - pricing sync may need to be run

success_rate.frontend: 90% (pages load, suppliers UI fully functional, products page has data quality display issues)

seed_data_creation: None - using real PromoStandards data from ATC supplier
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-supplier integration is working. ATC connection succeeds, S&S returns 403 (IP blocked by WAF - expected). Product sync populates products but some have 'Array' or 'Error Product' names due to SOAP parsing. Media thumbnails need media sync to be triggered. Backend pytest suite created at /app/backend/tests/test_supplier_crud.py with 23 comprehensive tests.
